# Reading theme probe

A zero-runtime community package with no entry or dependencies. The tiny PNG is a
static public texture; no webview or bridge permission is involved.

Validate with `mise exec -- pnpm validate:plugin tests/third-party/theme-pack-probe`.
Zip this directory's contents and install through the plugin installer. Enable it
for a session, open **Session theme**, select **Reading room · theme-pack-probe**,
and apply. Nothing is selected automatically. **Use default appearance** removes
the pack without changing the base theme or player overrides. A content update
requires explicit reselection. The choice belongs to this device and session.
